cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.
